name: Heavy loader droid
description: The heavy loader droid, or the heavy loading droid, was a model of class five loader droid produced by JLD Mechanicals Consortium, and used for loading heavy objects, often working with starfighter ground crews. The Resistance droid B-U4D, known as "Buford," was a heavy loader droid. B-R72 was also a heavy loader droid that worked near the Droid Depot on the planet Batuu.
